source: make a clicker game where you tap for clicks and I want a VERY DETAILED map that I can walk around in, give me a button on my screen called adminenpanel that only I HAVE and make it so I can do events and give clicks, there is to be no labels around the map or on the ground and I want a rebirth button on my screen and rebirthing doubles how much you get per click

image_prompt.text: A central storefront zone the player keeps returning to for upgrades
Physical walls blocking higher-tier parts of the map that vanish once bought
Walkable circulation chaining the centre of the map to everywhere worth walking to
A very detailed walkable map with no signs, labels or text anywhere in the world or on the ground

notes: This is a clicker, which normally routes P5, but the user explicitly asks for a detailed map to walk around in, so there is a space to build.
The map has no gameplay function in this prompt - the whole loop is on-screen buttons - so every option below is preset-derived rather than requested.
Preset caveat: the incremental-simulator bundle puts progression in the world, which fights the prompt's on-screen rebirth and admin buttons and its ban on labels.

open_questions.ask: You asked for a very detailed map but did not say what it is - a city, a forest, an island, something else?
How big should the walkable area be - a plaza, a neighbourhood, or a whole world?

coverage_missing.ask: What is the detailed map actually of? Nothing in the prompt says whether it is a city, a landscape, or an interior.
Does walking around the map earn anything, or is it purely somewhere to be while you tap?
How much ground should the map cover?

answers.ask: You asked for a very detailed map but did not say what it is - a city, a forest, an island, something else?
answers.answer: Make it a detailed modern city map, with streets, buildings, parks, and interior-style decorative detail but no labels placed around the map or on the ground.

answers.ask: How big should the walkable area be - a plaza, a neighbourhood, or a whole world?
answers.answer: Use a neighbourhood-sized walkable area so it feels detailed and explorable while staying focused for the clicker game.
